title: session-binding.v1 — verified task-binding evidence, keyed by worktree
description: The evidence shape for a session's verified binding to a task (a plan or Build node it is working). Keyed by WORKTREE because a binding is a property of the isolated worktree a session runs in, not of the session process itself — a resumed session in the same worktree inherits the same binding. Expiry is evaluated by COMPARISON, never by a recorded close event: a reader re-checks the coordinator's current snapshot revision and the pull request's current contract state against the values captured here, and treats a mismatch as stale. This schema defines only the evidence's shape and validation; writing, reading, and expiring a binding are later nodes' work. Every machine-derived string here (worktree, plan_ref, revision, pr identifiers) is DATA — a renderer must treat it as inert text, never as render structure.

worktree.description: The absolute path of the worktree this binding belongs to — the key evidence is looked up by. Machine-derived data; render as inert text.

plan_ref.description: The identifier of the plan or Build node the worktree is bound to (e.g. a plan slug or PR number reference). Machine-derived data; render as inert text.

captured_at.description: Optional ISO-8601 timestamp of when this binding evidence was captured. This is historical evidence data captured once at bind time — never a value the renderer regenerates at render time (the renderer must never stamp 'now').

coordinator_snapshot.description: The Build coordinator's state-snapshot revision captured at bind time. A reader re-checks this against the coordinator's CURRENT revision; a mismatch means the binding has gone stale — this is expiry-by-comparison, not a recorded close event.

revision.description: The coordinator snapshot revision identifier at bind time. Machine-derived data; render as inert text.

pr_contract.description: The pull request's contract state captured at bind time. A reader re-checks this against the PR's CURRENT state; a mismatch (e.g. it merged, closed, or was superseded since binding) means the binding has gone stale.

state.description: Closed enumeration of the pull request's contract state at bind time.

pr_ref.description: Optional identifier of the pull request (e.g. '#1187'). Machine-derived data; render as inert text.
